fullPassage: 'I'll believe it when I see it.' This familiar remark recalls how first-hand personal experience is commonly accepted as a convincing way — if not the fundamental way — to determine what to believe in. Many centuries ago, for instance, it was unbelievable that there could be organisms so small as to be invisible to the naked eye. Opinions changed after microscopes allowed us to see these tiny creatures in the late 1600s. This emphasis upon direct personal experience is philosophically expandable to the point of prescribing how words must derive their meaning. The prescription would be: if any given word is to be meaningful, then it must be traceable back to some sensory experience. Otherwise, the word should be regarded as only a meaningless sound. This experience-tied theory of meaning was advocated by the Scottish philosopher David Hume, an empiricist who believed that knowledge of what exists or is true can only come from observing the world.

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a person who believes that all knowledge comes from experience and observation rather than from theory"

det.korean: 이론보다 경험과 관찰에서 모든 지식이 나온다고 믿는 사람
det.analysis:
❌ ① optimist(낙관론자): 긍정적으로 보는 사람, 정의와 무관
❌ ② narrator(서술자): 이야기를 전하는 사람
❌ ③ economist(경제학자): 경제를 연구하는 사람
✅ ④ empiricist(경험주의자): 지식이 경험·관찰에서 온다고 믿는 사람 ← 정답
det.tip: empiricist=경험주의자. 흄이 대표적 인물

questions.passage: This familiar remark recalls how first-hand personal experience is commonly __________ (accept) as a convincing way — if not the fundamental way — to determine what to believe in.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: accept → accepted: 'is commonly ~ed' 수동태 과거분사 형태
det.analysis: accept(동사원형) → accepted(과거분사). 'is commonly accepted(흔히 받아들여진다)'는 be동사 + 과거분사 수동태. 경험이 '받아들여지는' 대상이므로 수동
det.tip: be + p.p. = 수동태. is accepted=받아들여진다

questions.passage: The prescription would be: if any given word is to be __________ (meaning), then it must be traceable back to some sensory experience.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: meaning → meaningful: 명사에 -ful을 붙여 '의미 있는'이라는 형용사로
det.analysis: meaning(명사, 의미) → meaningful(형용사, 의미 있는). 'is to be ______'의 빈칸은 보어 자리라 형용사 필요. 조건절 논리상 '의미 있으려면 감각 경험으로 추적 가능해야'가 자연스러움
det.tip: 명사 + -ful = 형용사. meaning→meaningful=의미 있는

questions.passage: 'I'll believe it when I see it.' This familiar remark recalls how first-hand personal experience is commonly accepted as a convincing way — if not the fundamental way — to determine what to believe in. Many centuries ago, for instance, it was unbelievable that there could be organisms so small as to be invisible to the __________. Opinions changed after microscopes allowed us to see these tiny creatures in the late 1600s. This emphasis upon direct personal experience is philosophically expandable to the point of prescribing how words must derive their meaning. The prescription would be: if any given word is to be meaningful, then it must be traceable back to some sensory experience. Otherwise, the word should be regarded as only a meaningless sound. This experience-tied theory of meaning was advocated by the Scottish philosopher David Hume, an empiricist who believed that knowledge of what exists or is true can only come from observing the world.

❌ ④ clear water(맑은 물): 문맥과 무관

det.analysis:
